notes: The qualified binary uses the generic C configuration, BLAS 32-bit integers, CBLAS enabled, pthreads plus single-thread runtime, and both shared/static libraries. Tuned architecture configurations remain in complete source but are not claimed as built by this profile.
The original fast BLIS numerical matrix and all twelve original BLAS test drivers run. Validation scripts are invoked directly because upstream make check ignores their error exit codes.

Fresh shared/static consumers compare 216 double GEMM shape/transpose/stride/thread-setting cases with a long-double scalar oracle, plus strided BLAS1 and native typed APIs. These are functionality checks, not performance scores.
BLIS_NUM_THREADS is controlled explicitly. OpenMP/HPX threading, full-size/mixed-domain/application-threaded upstream matrices and cross-platform qualification are not claimed.
The original material profile and source locks are preserved. Installed pkg-config paths are relative; upstream make metadata remains available with its original configured context.
usage.summary: BLIS generic portable C kernels, shared/static BLAS and CBLAS, native typed/object APIs and explicit pthread threading.
